name: FWD Group Holdings Limited
summary: FWD Group Holdings Limited and its subsidiaries provide life insurance products and services, reporting segments for Hong Kong and Macau, Thailand and Cambodia, Japan, emerging markets, and corporate and others. It also sells accident and health insurance and savings plans, distributes investment and financial products, and underwrites general insurance. Incorporated in 2013 and based in Taikoo Shing, it was formerly PCGI Intermediate Holdings Limited.
